title: Dual DNA-binding capability of Cdc13 coordinates with Ku to safeguard telomere integrity
authors: Zhitong Feng; Jiangchuan Shen; Yuxi Li; Giovanni Gonzalez-Gutierrez; Quan Wang; Hengyao Niu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酵母Cdc13蛋白与端粒单链及双链DNA的结合能力及其与Ku复合物的协同保护机制，属于蛋白质-DNA互作体系，但主要依赖实验方法，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: In eukaryotes, telomeres, nucleoprotein complexes assembled on telomeric 3’-overhang DNA, protect linear chromosome ends from degradation and inappropriate DNA repair. In budding yeast, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, telomere assembly involves the Cdc13-Stn1-Ten1 (CST) complex, the Ku70-Ku80 (Ku) complex, and the Rap1-Rif1-Rif2 complex. Among these, the CST complex, centered on the binding of the G-rich single-stranded region by the Cdc13 subunit, is essential for telomere maintenance and protection. Here, we show that Cdc13 also interacts with the duplex DNA adjoining its bound single strand. This junction binding enables Cdc13 to reposition the Ku complex, potentially suppressing Ku-mediated end joining, while allowing the Cdc13 and Ku complexes to synergize in protecting telomeric DNA ends, a function that can be disrupted by mutation of a conserved residue (K504E). cdc13-K504E cells remain viable but are hypersensitive to Exo1 overexpression, particularly when combined with ku80Δ . Surprisingly, cdc13-K504E and other telomere protection mutants are prone to adaptive metabolic reprogramming during stationary-phase growth, leading to increased fitness. This reprogramming is inheritable and centers on elevated expression of thiamine biosynthesis, salvage, and intake pathways. Our findings reveal a stress-induced adaptive response associated with telomere erosion, indicating that telomere erosion may serve as a timer for its activation.
abstract_zh: 在真核生物中，端粒是由端粒3’突出端DNA组装而成的核蛋白复合物，保护线性染色体末端免于降解和不适当的DNA修复。在芽殖酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中，端粒组装涉及Cdc13-Stn1-Ten1（CST）复合物、Ku70-Ku80（Ku）复合物以及Rap1-Rif1-Rif2复合物。其中，以Cdc13亚基结合富含G的单链区域为核心的CST复合物，对端粒维持和保护至关重要。在此，我们表明Cdc13还与其所结合单链相邻的双链DNA发生相互作用。这种连接结合使Cdc13能够重新定位Ku复合物，可能抑制Ku介导的末端连接，同时允许Cdc13和Ku复合物协同保护端粒DNA末端，该功能可因保守残基突变（K504E）而被破坏。cdc13-K504E细胞仍可存活，但对Exo1过表达高度敏感，尤其是在与ku80Δ结合时。令人惊讶的是，cdc13-K504E和其他端粒保护突变体在稳定期生长过程中倾向于发生适应性代谢重编程，导致适应性增强。这种重编程是可遗传的，并以硫胺素生物合成、补救和摄取途径的升高表达为核心。我们的发现揭示了一种与端粒侵蚀相关的应激诱导适应性反应，表明端粒侵蚀可能作为其激活的计时器。
